text:
rina_marketing: Quick thread - want to run a tightly scoped PLG experiment tied to the Ember workshop launch. Objective: increase "first-success" (user runs a provided template successfully) and validate which creative + onboarding combo moves the needle.

tyler_growth: short take: love the micro test. what's the high level funnel and cohorts?

rina_marketing: plan:
- 3 cohorts: baseline (no extras), credits-only, credits+prompt-pack+nudges
- 2.5k credits pool allocated (can expand if finance OK)
- prompt-pack = 5 tiny templates (summarize long text, shorten for tweet, brainstorm ideas, refactor snippet, product QA checklist) delivered immediately on signup
- nudges: day1 toast + day2 email + day5 micro-webinar invite

zoe_product: primary KPI = % who run any template within 72h (event: prompt.execute.template). secondary: conversion to paid within 14d, avg tokens per run, time-to-first-run. Success = +5pp vs baseline.

lucy_analytics: I'll need experiment_id on signup and on prompt.execute. Also want to capture UTM creative variant for launch posts to tie creative to behavior.

omar_design: creative note: for launch posts we're testing two narratives: "benchmark story" (cost/latency comparison) vs "quick win story" (how to ship a feature in 10 minutes). I'll deliver assets for both.

tyler_growth: routing: auto-tag workshop signups with cohort=ember-flight, enroll until 2.5k or 21 days. Manual outreach to top 150 signups (high token users) for feedback.

ops_bot: experiment recorded: exp.ember_flight.1709999991 | cohorts: baseline/credits/full | allocation configured | tag=experiment_id=exp.ember_flight.1709999991

rina_marketing: action items:
- rina: finalize budget + brief (today)
- omar: creative assets for both narratives + short launch-post captions (tomorrow AM)
- zoe: wire up follow-up rules + conversion tagging (ETA Wed)
- lucy: dashboard + SQL cohorts + power calc (ETA Wed)
- tyler: manual outreach plan for top 150 (ETA Fri)

tyler_growth: noted. will prep outreach snippets and a short tracking doc.

lucy_analytics: will post dashboard link when events are live.

rina_marketing: thanks team 1. If no blocks i'll flip the switch next Tuesday. Ping me here if anything unacceptable.
